serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I think I heard something about it, someone I know was getting a free working force from the labour office.
Lady Annalie: If they didn’t refuse me the first 3 times maybe I would get some help also, but now they told me most of the funds are already spent and I got 2000$ for like 30k$ of proven damages!
Lady Annalie: I pay much more in local taxes so the mayor is not doing me any favours!
Lady Annalie: I wonder how your friend got past these bureaucrats at the town hall, I heard that the rejection rate was super high!
#Annalie.face.shocked
You: He’s not a friend of mine I assure you and he probably had some underhanded methods.
#Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.sad
Lady Annalie: Anon…{{wi}} I can’t believe you associate with some suspicious people… I thought you were a good boy…
You: As I said! He’s not my friend! I just rent a flat from him, that’s all.
#Annalie.face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: I’m just teasing you silly, chill~
